digest.component_or_area: codebase remediation / GitHub Code Quality findings
propositions: Environment inheritance bug in reconcile_helpers._read_local_tickets and run_differs._read_local_ticket_full: when no_sync=False, subprocess inherits parent REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off instead of being explicitly controlled.
Dead capability flag _HAVE_ASTGREP defined but unused in test_conformance.py and test_coverage_reconstruction.py (test_engine_b.py legitimately uses it and must be retained).
Inconsistent BatchRunner.run signature between base class and ProductionBatchRunner; agent_runner parameter should be optional across all implementations for mypy override compatibility.
Verified dead symbols in Tier-2 files include duplicate constants, unused reverse maps, and orphaned imports that can be safely removed without impact.
Input-contract validation must be demonstrated as category-agnostic via non-review (transform) test in test_validation_depth.py.
All removals verified by grep and static analysis; no dangling references or false positives after cleanup.
